answer.summary: Two new toolbar layout tests at 1400px (grid and list view) fail because the 'Go to next page' button never appears, so toBeInViewport times out after 15s. The PR redesigns the list toolbar and touches PaginationComponentV2.tsx and the list components, so this is likely a real change-caused failure, not a flake. Uncertain: the excerpt omits the test setup, and the test also failed once before (persisted 1x), so missing data (a single page of results) is possible.
